scope: One frozen development prompt; diagnose first different target decision; no timing claim.

messages.content: Apply the principles of Newton's method, a root-finding algorithm, to determine the cube root of a specific number, which in this case is 27. This process requires iterative approximation, so please detail each step.

target_and_numerical_policy: Reuse frozen pretrained screen target, sparse, mHC and expert policies unchanged.
required_controls: Reproduce each prior 64-token output prefix without tracing.
Before/passive capture/repeat capture/after must preserve tokens and speculative counters within each drafter.
Trace must retain accepted history and select the actual decision row at the common-prefix boundary.
If instrumentation changes outputs, retain failure; do not attribute cause from a different trajectory.
retain: Actual target input tokens, positions, graph descriptor and padded row count.
Pre/post-sampler full vocabulary logits around first divergence, top ties and selected IDs.
Draft proposals, accepted lengths, computed-token counts and cache-slot/rollback metadata.
Auxiliary features with per-arm six/five layer maps; do not reuse a hard-coded five-tap assertion.

decision_tree.same_target_logits_different_selected_to: Audit greedy tie handling, logit processing and accept/reject bookkeeping.
decision_tree.different_logits_equal_accepted_history: Compare actual cached state and per-layer boundaries; isolate the first differing operation.
decision_tree.different_cache_state_at_shared_prefix: Replay accepted/rejected speculative positions and rollback indexing before changing arithmetic.
decision_tree.suspected_kernel: Replay equal shared rows/state while changing only future proposed rows; compare native and compressed path using equal weights.

target_only_control: Use a separate speculation-off run as a diagnostic reference, with explicit row-shape/cache-layout differences; disagreement alone does not locate a bug.
execution_prerequisites: Current frozen timing comparison finishes and original production is verified restored.
Adapt and test passive probe for both drafter architectures; existing probe assumes five taps.
Freeze diagnostic sources and install a bounded original-service restoration controller.
